items.title: 1-800-MIKEY – “Pleasant Morning”
items.summary: Recording and performing under the name 1-800-MIKEY, Sydney's Michael Barker (also of Gee Tee and RMFC) is on the poppier end of the vital Australian punk/garage rock scene. He announced In Yun, his new album for Goner Records, a few weeks back with the release of lead single "Me And My Only," a lo-fi power-pop heater that dares to imagine what the Buzzcocks might sound like with Thin Lizzy riffs. He's back today with another gem.

items.title: Robert Pollard’s Band Rip Van Winkle Changes Name To The U.S. Rip Van Winkle, Announces New Self-Titled Album
items.summary: When not cranking out new Guided By Voices albums at an impossible clip, American lo-fi rock 'n' roll hero Robert Pollard also creates music under alternate guises. As of two years ago, those ventures include Rip Van Winkle, a new band that aligns Pollard with a cast of Dayton-based musicians entirely separate from the dudes that fill out GBV's current lineup.
